proposals.expected_effect: Reject opportunities whose modeled edge cannot cover chain-specific execution costs.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 eligible forward-SHADOW opportunities per chain across three or more market regimes, with complete executable quotes and no promotion from simulations alone.
proposals.rationale: These controls align selection with executable NET P&L and prevent forced trading. They are architecture safeguards, not profitability evidence.
proposals.shadow_test: For each chain, replay time-ordered quotes with contemporaneous fees, slippage, impact, latency and failed-attempt costs. Fail if any eligible signal had non-positive modeled edge or if realized net edge shows material adverse calibration.

proposals.downside_risk: Valuation joins and failure attribution can introduce bias unless prices, timestamps and attribution rules are immutable and auditable.

evidence.detail: Windows record net profit and execution-failure counts, but the schema lacks an explicit chain, valuation numeraire, capital exposure, and separate STRATEGY/MARKET versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE loss amounts.
Quote-simulated net is explicitly non-promotional; no realized outcome layer is present.

proposals.expected_effect: Comparable capital-weighted NET P&L, drawdown and profit-factor evidence by strategy, chain and failure class.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 50 resolved attempts per chain, including at least 10 execution failures or an equivalent injected-failure suite, with 100% accounting reconciliation and explicit loss attribution.
proposals.rationale: Native/base-unit sums across chains are not safely comparable or money-weighted. Execution failures can consume gas or priority fees without being strategy losses. Outcome evidence should classify STRATEGY/MARKET loss separately from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure and retain both economic costs.
proposals.shadow_test: Record notional, capital-at-risk duration, chain, native and common-numeraire values, all costs, execution state and loss class for every attempted SHADOW trade. Reconcile gross proceeds minus fees, slippage, impact, gas/priority fees and failed-attempt costs to net P&L. Stop if reconciliation is non-zero beyond rounding tolerance or any failure is ambiguously classified.

proposals.downside_risk: Quote-only results may overstate fill quality, particularly during congestion, low liquidity and rapid token deterioration.

evidence.detail: Solana leader events are emitted with zero edge/cost/quality fields, outcome basis SIGNAL_ONLY_MISSING_CURRENT_EXECUTABLE_EDGE, and needs_quote_feature_adapter=true.
